findings.text: The company is in administration, with the insolvency case recorded as administration started on 12 December 2025.
Accounts are overdue; they were last made up to 30 December 2023, and the next accounts were due 30 December 2025.
The confirmation statement is overdue; it was last made up to 22 May 2025, and the next statement is due 5 June 2026.
The register records 2 outstanding and 2 satisfied charges, 4 in total.

The register lists 2 current persons with significant control: F. BLACK, who the register describes as a convicted criminal, with 25 to 50 percent ownership of shares and voting rights, and PERSON 327, with significant influence or control.

The 2 current directors, PERSON 320 (appointed 1 May 2006) and PERSON 321 (appointed 10 February 2004), have 11 other company appointments in total across the network checked, including 1 in administration.
A registered office address change was filed on 29 December 2025, and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
